args.message: fix(money): use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
Fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`, which expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212).

## Problem
`src/money.py` was quantizing with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, which fails the assertion `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")` (HALF_UP would produce 2.67).

## Change
Replaced `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money` so cents are rounded using banker's rounding, as documented in the docstring.

## Verification
- CI run ci-0001 on this branch passed.
